mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 0.79% is at a historically low level, which is indicative of an expansionary monetary policy, reducing the risk-free rate and increasing the present value of equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns from the current date are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 245.0 indicates accelerating inflation, which triggers central bank tightening and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 245.0 and the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust economic demand, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy avoids a recession and growth remains strong.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS and HOUST both increase, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals a supply shock, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased inflation and central bank tightening.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 and the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: The current unemployment rate of 4.5% is at a historically low level, indicating a tight labor market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as strong labor conditions support consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns from the current date are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200.0 signals weakening economic demand, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy faces a potential slowdown.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1200.0 and the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises rapidly without a corresponding increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS), it signals inadequate monetary policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in the risk of a policy error.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% monthly and FEDFUNDS does not rise > 0.25% monthly
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% monthly and FEDFUNDS does not rise > 0.25% monthly, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A strong GDP growth (GDPC1) above 16800.0 billion dollars signals a late-cycle economy, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in the risk of a policy error and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: GDPC1 > 16800.0 and the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances.
